findings.title: Webhook get_or_create + select_for_update sequence is not actually race-safe
findings.problem: get_or_create does not lock the created row and select_for_update cannot lock a not-yet-existing row; concurrent same-event deliveries either 500 on an uncaught IntegrityError or both pass the UNKNOWN_PAYMENT gate and double-apply. The described call sequence does not provide the serialization the race fix depends on.
findings.fix: Specify the exact sequence: get_or_create(defaults UNKNOWN_PAYMENT), then re-read the row via select_for_update().get(pk=...) in BOTH the created and existing branches before checking terminal status or mutating, and explicitly catch a concurrent-insert IntegrityError on event_id and treat it as 'row exists -> re-read under lock'.

findings.title: Signature test/live mode selection has no valid derivation
findings.problem: mode is said to derive from whether the configured key is test or live, but the webhook signing secret (PAYMONGO_WEBHOOK_SECRET, whsec_...) carries no test/live marker and the design conflates it with the API secret key (sk_test_/sk_live_). As written mode is undeterminable and the one test only pins message shape, never which of te/li is compared, so prod can reject every live signature while tests pass.
findings.fix: Derive mode from PAYMONGO_SECRET_KEY prefix (sk_test_ -> test, sk_live_ -> live) with an explicit offline default (mode=test when empty), and add a test asserting te is compared in test mode and li in live mode.

findings.title: Assumed signature scheme shipped in-scope with no bytes-exact handling or structural-mismatch fallback
findings.where: apps/billing webhook step 1 confirmation note; scope item 4
findings.problem: The scheme is honestly flagged as assumed, but the webhook is still an in-scope deliverable whose unit tests encode the guess and will go green, and f"{t}.{raw_body.decode()}" is not byte-exact (corrupts non-UTF-8/re-encoded bodies). No contract is stated for a structurally different real scheme.
findings.fix: Operate on raw_body as bytes throughout (sign t.encode() + b'.' + raw_body, never decode()), and state the fallback: if confirmation reveals a structurally different scheme, verify_signature and its fixture are rewritten in the billing pass and no real webhook traffic is accepted until then.

findings.title: ALLOWED_HOSTS production behavior underspecified; can 400 every request
findings.problem: The design never states how the Vercel domain enters ALLOWED_HOSTS, nor what happens when the var is unset under DEBUG=False. A localhost-only or empty fallback makes Django raise DisallowedHost (400) on every production request.
findings.fix: Read ALLOWED_HOSTS from env (csv) requiring the Vercel + custom domains, document in .env.example, and fail fast with ImproperlyConfigured when unset under DEBUG=False rather than silently falling back to localhost. Optionally default from VERCEL_URL.

findings.title: Mobile login CSRF path left as an unresolved either/or on the critical path
findings.problem: The one in-scope mobile screen cannot authenticate without a decided login flow, but the design leaves 'CSRF-token-echo OR CSRF-exempt login endpoint' unresolved. The two options have materially different security postures and the token path's prerequisite GET is not sequenced.
findings.fix: Pick the CSRF-token-echo path: GET an ensure_csrf_cookie endpoint, then POST credentials with X-CSRFToken and credentials:'include'; state no CSRF-exempt login endpoint is created this pass; document the full request sequence (GET csrf -> POST login -> GET /api/membership/me/ -> GET /api/attendance/).

findings.title: django-components==0.100 wiring pinned but unverified against that version
findings.where: requirements.txt and Web portal shell sections
findings.problem: INSTALLED_APPS entry, template_loader.Loader, and COMPONENTS['dirs'] are unverifiable in-workspace and the 0.100 API shape changed across releases.
findings.fix: Keep the pin; add 'manage.py check passes with the component rendering in a template' to the implementation acceptance so a wrong loader path fails the gate.

findings.title: Pooler port WARNING check misfires on URL-default (empty) port
findings.problem: env.db_url can parse PORT as '' when the URL omits the port, so the '==5432 -> warn' advisory never fires for a direct connection on the default port.
findings.fix: Normalize empty port to the scheme default before comparing (or compare against '', '5432', 5432); state the warning is advisory only.

findings.title: All-traffic rewrite vs WhiteNoise static serving not reconciled
findings.problem: Routing '/(.*)' into the single function means static assets are served by WhiteNoise inside the function rather than Vercel edge/CDN, paying an invocation cost. Consistent but not called out as a deliberate choice.
findings.fix: Add one line that static is intentionally served via WhiteNoise in-function for first-build simplicity, with CDN/static-hosting optimization noted as a later task.

findings.title: No guard against out-of-order paid/failed webhook deliveries
findings.problem: paid and failed are distinct event_ids so idempotency does not merge them; nothing prevents a late failed from overwriting a settled paid (or vice versa). Low impact while billing is stubbed, but the single-writer mutators inherit the gap.
findings.fix: Note (even if deferred to the billing pass) that mark_payment_paid/mark_payment_failed guard against illegal/stale transitions so out-of-order redelivery cannot flip a settled payment.
